title: Room pack manifest v1 (manifest.json)
description: One pack = one space (room). The map is a Tiled JSON export (.tmj) whose object layer marks desks, doors, benches, boards and props; this manifest declares metadata, license, the object naming convention, and per-state animation/prop overrides. Unknown fields are ignored.

license.description: REQUIRED. SPDX identifier or an object for custom terms (same shape as the character pack). Packs without a license are refused at load time.

space.description: Space id (office, tax, school, warehouse, lab, lounge, or custom).

map.description: Relative path to the Tiled JSON map.

tilesets.description: Relative image paths referenced by the map (must stay inside the pack folder).

markers.description: Which Tiled object classes the map provides. Objects are matched by their `class`/`type` field; boards also need the custom property `board_kind`.

boss_desk.description: A spot that animation_overrides can name with go_to (optional). Characters that need the user wait where they are, so the engine does not send waiting_user here.

board.description: board_kind values present. Text on boards is rendered by the engine with a crisp font, not by sprites.

animation_overrides.description: Per-state action/prop overrides for this room (state meaning never changes). Keys are states.

animation.description: Alternative character animation tag if the character pack provides it (falls back to the standard tag).

prop.description: Room prop id to show next to the character (e.g. calculator, stamp).

go_to.description: Where the character moves for this state.

lights.description: Room dims when it has no active session.
